remediations.title: Optimistic Concurrency Token Propagation & 409 Conflict Rollback
remediations.changes_summary: Added version and timeline_hash fields to Case and CaseSummary. Added expected_status, expected_version, and expected_timeline_hash to CaseStatusUpdatePayload, CaseSignPayload, and CaseResolvePayload. Updated useUpdateCaseStatus, useSignCase, and useResolveCase with onError cache invalidation handlers. Wired tokens through handleStatusChange and handleFourEyesConfirm in CaseDetailPage.

remediations.title: False-Positive & Unreviewed Case SAR Report Eligibility Enforcement
remediations.changes_summary: Updated Export FinCEN XML button to disabled={isExportingXml || !isFincenEligible}. Added state-specific tooltips distinguishing false positives ('SAR filing prohibited: Case is resolved as False Positive') from unreviewed cases ('Regulatory SAR XML requires Closed (Confirmed) status under Four-Eyes dual control') and dynamic status badges.

remediations.title: Active Tenant Cache Isolation and Session Context Purge
remediations.changes_summary: Implemented and exported getActiveTenantId, setClientTenant, and switchActiveTenant(queryClient, newTenantId) which coordinates localStorage update and invokes queryClient.clear() to eliminate cross-tenant cache bleeding.

remediations.title: Webhook Gateway Tab, SSRF Error Presentation & Test Dispatch Hook
remediations.changes_summary: Implemented useWebhookTestDispatchMutation in queries.ts for POST /api/v1/webhooks/test-dispatch. Added 'webhooks' tab to SecurityPage with subscription registration, strict SSRF filtering notices (RFC 1918 / loopback / cloud metadata), synthetic test event dispatch, and delivery audit log viewer with DELIVERED/FAILED badges and at-least-once transport notes.
